items.Sentence: Treatment at the Newhall Ranch WRP will consist of screening for removal of large solids...
Grit... will be removed by settling.
Influent grinding. Solids such as paper and rags would be ground prior to entering the treatment process...

Step Feed Activated Sludge (SFAS). Biological treatment using SFAS with nitrification and denitrification will be used to remove nitrogen from the wastewater. The SFAS system will consist of two anoxic zones and two aerobic zones.
Membrane Bioreactor (MBR) filtration. A suspended growth biological reactor that utilizes ultrafiltration membranes will be used as a secondary treatment process...
Reverse Osmosis (RO). Reverse osmosis treatment is proposed for a portion of the MBR treated effluent at the Newhall Ranch WRP to achieve chloride reduction.
Ultraviolet (UV) disinfection. Irradiation with UV light will be used as the method of disinfection at the Newhall Ranch WRP.
Chlorination. Sodium hypochlorite will be used as a cleaning agent for the bioreactor membranes.
Flow Equalization. Flow equalization will be provided in the Newhall Ranch WRP through in-tank equalization and an onsite storage pond (with a 0.8 mgd holding capacity).
In-tank equalization will be achieved by providing 6 feet of freeboard in the membrane bioreactor tank...

Sewage solids separated from the wastewater will either be dewatered with a belt thickener and trucked to the Valencia WRP... Sludge may be disposed of using one of two options: ... trucking the dewatered sludge from a gravity belt thickener to the Valencia WRP during later phases of construction.
Grit and bar screenings will be hauled off-site for disposal in a landfill.

Sewage solids separated from the wastewater will either be dewatered with a belt thickener and trucked to the Valencia WRP or pumped through a pipe to the Valencia WRP for processing, where treatment and disposal will occur, regulated under Valencia WRP’s NPDES permit.
